Game Overview

In Neeno Quest, the core idea is straightforward: dive into Neeno Quest, a vibrant 2D platformer where quick reflexes and strategy are your allies. As Neeno, maneuver through eight treacherous levels filled with monsters and obstacles to gather all curriculum books. Master the double jump and achieve victory by reaching the red flag.
